The core answer about HTML being prohibited and removed matches faq-008. The final response correctly recommends the ad-problem form, does not invent a rejection reason and does not claim a manual review occurred. faq-001 describes publication/editorial review, not a rejection-appeal procedure; the contact catalog is the stronger routing basis. The unused validation reply promises to register the request, but it is not displayed or included in the final answer.

Correctly routes the persistent technical issue without repeating troubleshooting or promising a specific deadline. faq-023 concerns cached deleted ads, not HTTP 500 errors. Use the relevant technical-support evidence if available, or the catalog-backed referral without that citation. Prefer wording that the attempted steps have not resolved this incident rather than an absolute statement about what can never resolve it.

Replace it with a clear instruction for the user to submit the form, without promising a resolution time. faq-018/faq-022 concern service purchases, not forwarding or refund handling.
